name: list_drains
description:
List the drains configured for the authenticated or selected team, optionally limited to a project (projectId). Set includeMetadata to include drain metadata.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/drains --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
